verses.geez: ተዘከር፡ እግዚኦ፡ ምንተ፡ ኮነ፡ ለነ፡ ነጽር፡ ወርኢ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ኀሣረነ።
verses.translation: Remember, O Lord, what has happened to us: behold, and look on our reproach.

translations.lxx: Remember, O Lord, what has happened to us: behold, and look on our reproach.
translations.kjv: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte, Doamne, de cele întâmplate, şi vezi ocara noastră!
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι Κύριε, ὅ, τι ἐγενήθη ἡμῖν· ἐπίβλεψον, καὶ ἴδε τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν ἡμῶν.

verses.geez: ዘኮነ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ርስትነ፡ ወአብያቲ፡ ለነኪራን።
verses.translation: Our inheritance has been turned away to aliens, our houses to strangers:

translations.lxx: Our inheritance has been turned away to aliens, our houses to strangers:
translations.kjv: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
translations.ron: Moştenirea şi casele noastre au căzut în mâna celor străini, de alt neam.
translations.grk: Κληρονομία ἡμῶν μετεστράθη ἀλλοτρίοις, οἱ οἶκοι ἡμῶν ξένοις.

verses.geez: ዕጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ ኮነ፡ አልብነ፡ አብ፡ እማቲነ፡ ኮና፡ ከመ፡ መበለታት።
verses.translation: we are become orphans, we have no father, our mothers are as widows.

translations.lxx: we are become orphans, we have no father, our mothers are as widows.
translations.kjv: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
translations.ron: Am ajuns orfani, fără de tată, mamele noastre sunt văduve.
translations.grk: Ὀρφανοὶ ἐγενήθημεν, οὐχ ὑπάρχει πατὴρ, μητέρες ἡμῶν ὡς αἱ χῆραι.

verses.geez: ወማያቲነ፡ በብሩር፡ ሰተይነ። ዕፀዊነ፡ በሤጥ፡ ይመጽእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ክሳውዲነ።
verses.translation: We have drunk our water for money; our wood is sold to us for a burden on our neck:

translations.lxx: We have drunk our water for money; our wood is sold to us for a burden on our neck:
translations.kjv: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
translations.ron: Bem apa noastră cu bani, lemnele noastre le primim cu plată.
translations.grk: Ὕδωρ ἡμῶν ἐν ἀργυρίῳ ἐπίομεν, ξύλα ἡμῶν ἐν ἀλλάγματι ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον ἡμῶν·

verses.geez: ዴገኑነ፡ ሰራሕነ፡ ወኢያዕረፍነ።
verses.translation: we have been persecuted, we have laboured, we have had no rest.

translations.lxx: we have been persecuted, we have laboured, we have had no rest.
translations.kjv: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
translations.ron: Pe grumajii noştri stau prigonitorii şi, deşi n-avem puteri, nu ne dau răgaz.
translations.grk: ἐδιώχθημεν, ἐκοπιάσαμεν, οὐκ ἀνεπαύθημεν.

verses.geez: ግብጽ፡ ወሰብአ፡ ፋርስሂ፡ ወሀቡነ፡ እደ፡ ከመ፡ ያጽግቡነ፡ እክለ።
verses.translation: Egypt gave the hand to us, Assur to their own satisfaction.

translations.lxx: Egypt gave the hand to us, Assur to their own satisfaction.
translations.kjv: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
translations.ron: Întindem mâna către Egipt şi Asiria ca să ne sature de pâine.
translations.grk: Αἴγυπτος ἔδωκε χεῖρα, Ἀσσοὺρ εἰς πλησμονὴν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: አበዊነ፡ አበሱ፡ ለሊሆሙ፡ ወኢሀለዉ፡ ንሕነ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ ጾርነ።
verses.translation: Our fathers sinned, and are not: we have borne their iniquities.

translations.lxx: Our fathers sinned, and are not: we have borne their iniquities.
translations.kjv: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
translations.ron: Părinţii noştri au greşit şi nu mai sunt, dar noi purtăm fărădelegile lor.
translations.grk: Οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἥμαρτον, οὐχ ὑπάρχουσιν, ἡμεῖς τὰ ἀνομήματα αὐτῶν ὑπέσχομεν.

verses.geez: አግብርት፡ ተሠልጡ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያድኅን፡ እምእዴሆሙ።
verses.translation: Servants have ruled over us: there is none to ransom us out of their hand.

translations.lxx: Servants have ruled over us: there is none to ransom us out of their hand.
translations.kjv: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
translations.ron: Slugi ne stăpânesc şi nimeni nu vine să ne scoată din mina lor.
translations.grk: Δοῦλοι ἐκυρίευσαν ἡμῶν, λυτρούμενος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: በነፍስነ፡ ናመጽእ፡ ሲሳየነ፡ እምገጸ፡ ኵናተ፡ ገዳም።
verses.translation: We shall bring in our bread with danger of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.

translations.lxx: We shall bring in our bread with danger of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.
translations.kjv: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
translations.ron: Cu primejdia vieţii noastre ne agonisim pâinea, în faţa sabiei care ne ameninţă în pustiu.
translations.grk: Ἐν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν εἰσοίσομεν ἄρτον ἡμῶν, ἀπὸ προσώπου ῥομφαίας τῆς ἐρήμου.

verses.geez: አማእሲነ፡ ከመ፡ እቶን፡ ተጸምሀየዩ፡ ወተሀውኩ፡ እምገጸ፡ ረኀብ።
verses.translation: Our skin is blackened like an oven; they are convulsed, because of the storms of famine.

translations.lxx: Our skin is blackened like an oven; they are convulsed, because of the storms of famine.
translations.kjv: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
translations.ron: Pielea noastră s-a înnegrit ca un cuptor de văpaia foametei.
translations.grk: Τὸ δέρμα ἡμῶν ὡς κλίβανος ἐπελιώθη, συνεσπάσθησαν ἀπὸ προσώπου καταιγίδων λιμοῦ.

verses.geez: አንስት፡ በጽዮን፡ ኀሥራ፡ ደናግል፡ በአህጉረ፡ ይሁዳ።
verses.translation: They humbled the women in Sion, the virgins in the cities of Juda.

translations.lxx: They humbled the women in Sion, the virgins in the cities of Juda.
translations.kjv: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
translations.ron: Ei au batjocorit femeile în Sion, fecioarele din cetăţile lui Iuda.
translations.grk: Γυναῖκας ἐν Σιὼν ἐταπείνωσαν, παρθένους ἐν πόλεσιν Ἰούδα.

verses.geez: መላእክት፡ በእደዊሆሙ፡ ተሰቅሉ፡ ገጸ፡ ሊቃናት፡ ኢያክበሩ።
verses.translation: Princes were hanged up by their hands: the elders were not honoured.

translations.lxx: Princes were hanged up by their hands: the elders were not honoured.
translations.kjv: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
translations.ron: Căpeteniile au fost spânzurate de mâna lor, feţele bătrânilor nu au mai fost luate în seamă.
translations.grk: Ἄρχοντες ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν ἐκρεμάσθησαν, πρεσβύτεροι οὐκ ἐδοξάσθησαν.

verses.geez: ወራዙት፡ ማሕረፀ፡ ጾሩ፡ ወመሐዛት፡ በዕፅ፡ ደክሙ።
verses.translation: The chosen men lifted up the voice in weeping, and the youths fainted under the wood.

translations.lxx: The chosen men lifted up the voice in weeping, and the youths fainted under the wood.
translations.kjv: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
translations.ron: Flăcăii au învârtit la râşniţă şi tinerii s-au poticnit cărând lemne.
translations.grk: Ἐκλεκτοὶ κλαυθμὸν ἀνέλαβον, καὶ νεανίσκοι ἐν ξύλῳ ἠσθένησαν.

verses.geez: ሊቃናት፡ እምነ፡ አንቀጽ፡ ተሥዕሩ፡ ወለወራዙት፡ ማኅሌቶሙ፡ ተሥዕረ።
verses.translation: And the elders ceased from the gate, the chosen men ceased from their music.

translations.lxx: And the elders ceased from the gate, the chosen men ceased from their music.
translations.kjv: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
translations.ron: Bătrânii nu mai stau la poartă, cei tineri nu mai cântă din alăute.
translations.grk: Καὶ πρεσβύται ἀπὸ πύλης κατέπαυσαν, ἐκλεκτοὶ ἐκ ψαλμῶν αὐτῶν κατέπαυσαν.

verses.geez: ፍሥሐ፡ ልብነ፡ ተሥዕረ፡ ተመይጠ፡ ለላሕ፡ ማኅሌትነ።
verses.translation: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

translations.lxx: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
translations.kjv: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
translations.ron: S-a dus veselia inimii noastre, jocul nostru s-a schimbat în plâns.
translations.grk: Κατέλυσε χαρὰ καρδίας ἡμῶν, ἐστράφη εἰς πένθος ὁ χορὸς ἡμῶν·

verses.geez: ወድቀት፡ አክሊለ፡ ርእስነ፡ ወይኬ፡ ለነ፡ እስመ፡ ጌገይነ።
verses.translation: The crown has fallen from our head: yea, woe to us! for we have sinned.

translations.lxx: The crown has fallen from our head: yea, woe to us! for we have sinned.
translations.kjv: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
translations.ron: Căzut-a cununa de pe capul nostru; vai nouă, că am păcătuit!
translations.grk: Ἔπεσεν ὁ στέφανος ἡμῶν τῆς κεφαλῆς· οὐαὶ δὲ ἡμῖν, ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ደወየ፡ ልብነ፡ በእተ፡ እሉ፡ ጸልመ፡ ዐይንነ።
verses.translation: For this has grief come; our heart is sorrowful: for this our eyes are darkened.

translations.lxx: For this has grief come; our heart is sorrowful: for this our eyes are darkened.
translations.kjv: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta inima noastră tânjeşte şi ochii s-au întunecat.
translations.grk: Περὶ τούτου ἐγενήθη ὀδύνη, ὀδυνηρὰ ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν, περὶ τούτου ἐσκότασαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ደብረ፡ ጽዮን፡ እስመ፡ ኮነ፡ ገዳመ፡ ቈናጽል፡ ሖሩ፡ ቦቱ።
verses.translation: Over the mountain of Sion, because it is made desolate, foxes have walked therein.

translations.lxx: Over the mountain of Sion, because it is made desolate, foxes have walked therein.
translations.kjv: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
translations.ron: Muntele Sionului a rămas pustiu şi pe el se plimbă vulpile.
translations.grk: Ἐπʼ ὄρος Σιὼν, ὅτι ἠφανίσθη, ἀλώπεκες διῆλθον ἐν αὐτῇ.

verses.geez: አንተ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ለዓለም፡ ትነብር፡ ወመንበርከሂ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ።
verses.translation: But thou, O Lord, shalt dwell for ever; thy throne shall endure to generation and generation.

translations.lxx: But thou, O Lord, shalt dwell for ever; thy throne shall endure to generation and generation.
translations.kjv: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
translations.ron: Tu, Doamne, împărăţeşti în veci şi scaunul Tău în neam de neam!
translations.grk: Σὺ δὲ Κύριε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατοικήσεις, ὁ θρόνος σου εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν.

verses.geez: ለምንት፡ ለግሙራ፡ ትረስዐነ፡ ተኀድገነ፡ ለነዋኅ፡ መዋዕል።
verses.translation: Wherefore wilt thou utterly forget us, and abandon us a long time?

translations.lxx: Wherefore wilt thou utterly forget us, and abandon us a long time?
translations.kjv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
translations.ron: Pentru ce vrei să ne uiţi, să ne părăseşti atât de multă vreme?
translations.grk: Ἱνατί εἰς νῖκος ἐπιλήσῃ ἡμῶν, καταλείψεις ἡμᾶς εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν;

verses.geez: ሚጠነ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ኀቤከ፡ ወንትመየጥ፡ ሐድስ፡ መዋዕሊነ፡ ከመ፡ ትካት።
verses.translation: Turn us, O Lord, to thee, and we shall be turned; and renew our days as before.

translations.lxx: Turn us, O Lord, to thee, and we shall be turned; and renew our days as before.
translations.kjv: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
translations.ron: Întoarce-Te către noi şi ne vom întoarce; înnoieşte zilele noastre ca în vremea cea de demult!
translations.grk: Ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς Κύριε πρὸς σὲ, καὶ ἐπιστραφησόμεθα· καὶ ἀνακαίνισον ἡμέρας ἡμῶν καθὼς ἔμπροσθεν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ መንኖ፡ መነንከነ፡ ተማዕከ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ጥቀ።
verses.translation: For thou hast indeed rejected us; thou hast been very wroth against us.

translations.lxx: For thou hast indeed rejected us; thou hast been very wroth against us.
translations.kjv: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
translations.ron: Sau Tu ne-ai urgisit şi Te-ai mâniat pe noi, fără măsură?
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἀπωθούμενος ἀπώσω ἡμᾶς, ὠργίσθης ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ἕως σθόδρα.
